title: Triangle of orbs follow him home and appear in his yard
summary: Bob McGwier tells of Triangle of orbs follow him home and appear in his yard, about undated at Blacksburg, Virginia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I had this video of a triangle of orbs going up and down making sure my security camera got it

plain: Bob McGwier, an engineer who says he did contract work for the CIA, the US spy agency, says a triangle of glowing balls of light followed him home to Blacksburg, Virginia, and showed up in his yard. He says he has video of them moving up and down as if to make sure his security camera caught them, which, if true, would mean they wanted to be seen.
